title: Every report row adds up to the report totals to the cent
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your location invoiced a split work order, a work order with one person on both sides and a part sale today.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Today {Location-A} has at least three invoices: one split work order, one work order with one person on both sides and one part sale.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with Show Unassigned on.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Click the chevron in the Date column header to expand every row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: every representative's invoice rows show. Adding up by hand every invoice row's Labor Invoiced, Parts Invoiced, Shop Supplies and Hrs Invoiced: each representative's summary row equals the sum of its invoice rows, and the report totals equal the sum of all invoice rows, to the cent (hours to two decimals).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R16: “A representative's summary row always shows real sums, never dashes.”
  • S5-R14: “With Show Unassigned on, the report's totals are the same whether invoices are split or not. With it off, a side credited to Unassigned is left out of the totals, as Unassigned money is today.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, rounding: “Σ rows = totals holds to the cent.”
